newsitem.title: SPAIN: Rato says Q4 may signal 98 growth above forecast.
newsitem.headline: Rato says Q4 may signal 98 growth above forecast.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday 1998 growth could be above forecast.
In the convergence plan through 2000, Spain estimated growth in 1998 would be 3.2 percent.

"In 1997 we will make the three percent growth target and the last quarter could suggest that growth in 1998 will be a little bit higher than forecast but I can't add anything more before we present the budget."
